thread:
Alex W: Hi! Quick question — the orientation calendar invite I got says 9:00 AM PDT, but when I add it to Outlook it shows up as 17:00 UTC for me and I’d miss it. Did the invite get created in the wrong timezone?
Maria G: hmm, that sounds like the invite was created in PT but Outlook tried to convert. What timezone is your Outlook set to?
Alex W: My Outlook is set to UTC. I assumed the invite would auto-adjust but the join link looks like it’s pinned to a time (zoom link has a start= param).
Jamal K: Zoom links are fine normally — the start param is just metadata. Outlook sometimes imports the .ics with a fixed timezone field though. Can you paste the invite header?
Alex W: Sure — pasted from the .ics:
```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART:20260415T160000Z
DTEND:20260415T170000Z
TZID:America/Los_Angeles
SUMMARY:Redwood New Hire Orientation
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```
Olivia S: Ah yep, DTSTART is in Z (UTC) and TZID is LA — Outlook handles that oddly if the file has both. If it shows 17:00 UTC then Outlook might be ignoring the TZID and using the Z time.
Rachael (People Ops): Sorry about the confusion! We schedule sessions in PT by default. We should send a corrected invite. @onboarding-bot can you reissue the invite with explicit timezone-only timestamps (no Z) and attach the recorded captioning opt-in? :pray:
onboarding-bot: Scheduled task queued — will create new invite, post recording link to onboarding wiki, and ping this thread when done.
Maria G: In the meantime as a workaround you can open the event in Outlook, go to Meeting > Time Zones and manually change it to Pacific Time then save and reopen. Or remove the event and accept the updated invite when we send it.
Alex W: Thanks — will try the manual change. Also, will the session be recorded and where do we find captions? I’m in CET so might watch the recording later.
Rachael (People Ops): Yes — we record every orientation. We’ll post the recording + transcript to the onboarding wiki under \"Orientation recordings\" within an hour after the session: https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding/orientation (public to employees). Captions are auto-generated and we also attach the human-edited summary.
Jamal K: If anyone in APAC needs a different session time, react with :hand: and we’ll try to add an APAC-friendly repeat next week.
Olivia S: FYI — if you use Google Calendar it tends to import the .ics better. Outlook is the one that flips between Z vs TZID.
Alex W: Got it — removed the event and will watch for the updated invite. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Rachael (People Ops): Updated invite sent just now (should show 9:00 AM PDT for attendees). I also added an alternative APAC slot (Friday 23:00 UTC) — feel free to accept that if it works better. I’ll post here once the recording is live.
Alex W: Received — now shows correctly. Appreciate it!
(onboarding-bot): Reminder scheduled: orientation recording will be posted to onboarding wiki after session.
